atrium.note: Atrium = open floor inside the ring of rooms; no explicit boundary is visible (ENV-001 Low). Reference points are floor projections of the bottom-centre of each object (est.); furniture is NOT part of the greybox.

DEPT-01.name: Executive Office
DEPT-01.notes: Front corners are angled in the reference (chamfer size ND). The sign floor anchor at partition-top height falls near the room centre, so the sign is not on the front facet; mounting ND (Q-ARCH-03).

DEPT-02.name: Marketing
DEPT-02.notes: Left extreme is hidden behind the sidebar (REG-02); true left extent ND (minimum shown).

DEPT-03.name: Engineering
DEPT-03.notes: Right extreme is hidden behind Live Activity (REG-06); measured envelope right edge is the clip line, so its envelope centre is biased.

DEPT-04.name: Creative Studio
DEPT-04.notes: Left extreme is hidden behind the sidebar (REG-02); true left extent ND (minimum shown).

DEPT-05.name: Management
DEPT-05.notes: Right extreme projects at x=1647 px, inside the frame; a vertical post is visible near x~1660 (y 485-595). The 02 envelope says the room runs off the edge, so the right side is treated as weakly constrained.

DEPT-06.name: Research
DEPT-06.notes: Fully visible; envelope vs digitised corner disagree by up to ~20 px (envelope confidence Medium).

DEPT-07.name: QA & Testing
DEPT-07.notes: Fully visible; sign wall z0 offset 0.46 m (sign plate probably mounted higher than partition top).

assumptions.A-SCALE-01: Desk working height = 0.75 m sets the metric scale (4 desks: 31-35 px; implied 0.72-0.80 m). Projection is scale-invariant: changing it rescales every length and the camera distance together.
assumptions.A-PP-01: Principal point = canvas centre (836, 470.5); the 3D canvas is the full 1672x941 frame (REG-03 is full-bleed).
assumptions.A-ROLL-01: Roll fixed at 0 deg (bootstrap 90% interval -1.08..+1.46 deg includes 0).
assumptions.A-HEAD-01: Robot head-centre heights used only for validation: seated 0.95 m, standing 1.20 m (est.).
assumptions.A-SIGN-01: Sign-plate centres are taken at partition-top height (2.07 m) when back-projected; +0.3 m moves walls by about 0.4-0.6 m.
assumptions.A-EXEC-SYM: Executive Office plan taken as square (size_x = size_z) because its envelope leaves one degree of freedom; it is an assumption, see Q-ARCH-03.
assumptions.A-DIG-01: Five partition floor corners were digitised by eye from 2x/4x crops (+-5 px) and used as constraints (variant D).

environment.note: Mission 006-A (WORA-3D-SCENE-006-A) environment measurements and scenery conventions. All values below were measured from the locked reference in a scratch probe (2026-11-20) except where marked est./assumed. Scenery (backdrop) is placed by back-projection onto the backdrop planes; its plane distances are assumptions (Q-ARCH-06: true building extents unknown).

fascia.note: Bright fascia band below the slab edge. Top = slab edge (y=0); bottom fitted (least squares, world m at the edge plane) from the strongest bright-to-dark step tracked under the model edge in the reference (scratch probe 2026-11-20; +Z 10 samples, +X 12 samples, exact edge-plane u solved with the HOME projector).

minusX.note: est.: straight band, styled after the +Z measured thickness range; no reference line measurable

minusZ.note: est.: straight band, styled after the +Z measured thickness range; no reference line measurable

facade_glazing.note: Lower-storey curtain wall below the fascia on +Z and +X (ENV-014/015). Bay 0.96 m from dark-column spacing ~50 px at ~52 px/m (ENV-015). Transoms est. Back edges (-X/-Z) reuse the same system above the floor (y 0..2.07, partition-height est.) as the exterior wall; mullion bay assumed identical.

backdrop.note: Environmental background scenery (CR-02 decision: treated as background, never building). Every element is placed by back-projecting a measured/eyeballed screen point onto an assumed scenery plane, so it projects back to its reference pixels in HOME by construction. All in-frame camera rays point below the horizon, so scenery lands below y=0 on distant planes; there is no ground plane in the scene. Orbit views are dev-only; HOME is the acceptance view.

terrace_parapet_right.note: white parapet band of the rooftop terrace behind Engineering (ENV-016 region); top-edge px read visually, +/-4 px
terrace_parapet_right.reset_note: reset: the ribbon top_pts world-y (−0.46…) are a documented artifact of the assumed plane; the visible reconstruction uses a constant balustrade top y=1.05 over the deck (EST., CR-06-style provisional)

terrace_parapet_left.note: same band behind Marketing; the world-height swing is a construction artifact of the assumed constant-x plane (scenery only)
terrace_parapet_left.reset_note: reset: the ribbon top_pts world-y (−0.46…) are a documented artifact of the assumed plane; the visible reconstruction uses a constant balustrade top y=1.05 over the deck (EST., CR-06-style provisional)

trees.note: greenery canopy discs (ENV-016 scenery + the large outdoor tree at the bottom-right frame edge); centres back-projected (bottom_right onto y=0 ground ray), radius from the plane scale. ENV-017 (right terrace greenery at px 1570,380) is OMITTED: its ray cannot be placed at a consistent 3D location (periphery); documented in the 006-A report.

left.prov: EST. deck filling the terrace between the building west edge (slab x=-14.6, CR-01) and the left parapet plane (x=-23.9, Q-ARCH-06); the reference shows a continuous bright stone terrace there — the reset render exposed a background hole

right.prov: EST. deck between the building north edge (z=-15.30, CR-02) and the right parapet plane (z=-21.9)

logo.note: back-projected from (901, 482.5) onto y=0.121 at 46 px/m; size from 68x31 px

wordmark.note: back-projected from (902, 511.5); reads along the screen-horizontal diagonal

rim.note: glowing rim = emissive ring band around the drum side (scene.plinth-rim #E5E2E6 peak), no bloom (post-processing is art-pass scope). Rendered as a cylinder r=2.393 h=0.118, just under the dais top (0.12) so the top face stays visible (flat-mode measurement requirement).

light_strips.note: Linear white strips along partition tops / floor edges (analysis/03 section 9 emissive sources). Emissive decision for Q-3D-07: strips are emissive (unlit); bloom deferred to the art pass.

slab_edge_base.note: along the two visible slab edges at the balustrade base

balustrade_frame.note: anthracite top rail + slender posts (scene.frame family). Bay 2.4 m est.: the reference balustrades read as glass with a thin rail; posts are sparse. Styling estimate, not a measurement.

interiors.note: VF-3 (2026-11-20): furniture placements derived from the catalogued screen-px boxes (analysis/03 §3-§6) via the approved HOME camera inverse projection (verified: plinth centre residual 0.23 m, SIGN-01 anchor exact). Widths FIT-derived from px; depths/heights type-standard EST. unless noted; wall items wall-adjacent EST. Content of displays recorded by type; chart artwork is ND at greybox level (art pass).
